decisions.reason: Garage door operators complement the firm's core garage door business, and its continuous in-house development lets it interpret results and refine the product line, which has its own web page.

A solid wood sectional door builds on the firm's sectional door know-how, though wood is less central to its metal materials expertise and the product is only mentioned, so dropping carries moderate risk.

The remote-controlled operator relates closely to the operator line and the firm's door systems, so its in-house development knowledge supports assimilation, although it may be merged into the broader operator range.
Glazed industrial sectional doors sit squarely in the firm's core industrial door competence, making early results easy to interpret and the product easy to improve.
The insulated glazed variant combines the firm's existing thermal and sectional door expertise, so it builds directly on related knowledge.
This core industrial door product has its own web page and lies directly within the firm's established knowledge base.
